readme:
# 11880.com Business Directory Scraper

Scrape business listings from [11880.com](https://www.11880.com), one of Germany's leading business directories with millions of entries.

## Features

- **Keyword + location search** — Find businesses by type and city (e.g., "Zahnarzt" in "Berlin")
- **Rich contact data** — Name, address, phone, mobile, email, website, fax
- **Category & services** — Primary category plus full list of services offered
- **Company details** — About text, legal form (Rechtsform)
- **Ratings & reviews** — Star ratings and review counts
- **Company logos** — Displayed as images in the dataset table
- **Opening hours** — Business hours when available
- **GPS coordinates** — Latitude and longitude for mapping
- **Detail page enrichment** — Optional deep scraping for full profiles
- **Pagination** — Automatically crawls multiple result pages
- **Pay-per-result pricing** — Only pay for what you scrape

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/11880-de-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `11880-de-scraper` to scrape company data from 11880 de. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Input Example

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "Wärmepumpe Installation",
  "location": "Hamburg",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Default |
|-----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `searchQuery` | string | Search keyword (e.g., "Rechtsanwalt", "Restaurant") | Required |
| `location` | string | City or region (e.g., "Berlin", "München") | Required |
| `maxResults` | number | Maximum results to return | 100 |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Fetch detail pages for full profiles | true |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Apify proxy settings | Auto |

## Pricing
